headline: Brent Crude Surges 13% in October Amid Middle East Supply Threats
summary: Brent crude futures are heading for a fourth consecutive monthly gain, rising nearly 13% in October as escalating Middle East hostilities threaten global oil supplies.
why: Oil price movements directly influence global energy costs, transportation inflation, and profit margins across energy-intensive sectors, making crude benchmarks vital for macroeconomic forecasting.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: The input explicitly reports a 13% surge in Brent crude futures driven by supply threats.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Escalating hostilities in the Middle East sparked immediate market fears of physical disruptions to crude shipments and global oil supplies.
